checks.detail: AC-028-01: Cohort class, roster & occurrence UTC + IANA timezone. Student join creates/retrieves single primary session per (student, occurrence).
AC-028-02: Roster CSV import handles validation, prevents duplicates, reports errors, and rejects students joining outside valid session window.
AC-028-03: Reschedule/cancel occurrence preserves audit trail, emits deduplicated notifications to enrolled students, and prevents rewriting past session history.
AC-029-01: Mentor dashboard scoped strictly to assigned classes. Progress and session summaries are accessible within scope.
AC-029-02: Revoked assignment immediately blocks mentor access (403 Forbidden). AuditLog recorded upon viewing session transcript (classroom:transcript:read).
AC-029-03: Dynamic class/student switching in mentor views maintains strictly scoped query keys without data leakage across accounts.
AC-030-01: Module settings registry validates modules, dependencies, and capability/navigation consistency.
AC-030-02: Attempting to disable core modules (auth, system) or modules with active dependents is rejected with impact report (409 Conflict) without DDL/data loss.
AC-030-03: Classroom drain mode blocks new sessions (503 Service Unavailable) while preserving in-flight sessions until completed.
Quality Gate: Backend (26 suites / 160 tests / 165 Bruno requests), CMS (15 suites / 72 tests / 1034 bilingual strings), Web (15 suites / 58 tests / 353 bilingual strings) all pass 100%.
